plain_definition: An SFC term for a stablecoin that Hong Kong's licensed virtual asset trading platforms and licensed corporations may handle under adjusted, lighter rules -- broadly, one of the stablecoins issued by an entity the Hong Kong Monetary Authority has licensed and authorised under the Stablecoins Ordinance.
formal_definition: A stablecoin that (i) qualifies as a "specified stablecoin" under section 4 of the Stablecoins Ordinance (Cap. 656) and (ii) is issued by an entity licensed under that Ordinance and authorised under such licence, per SFC Circular 26EC26.
